title: FLARE-WSN: code, data and results for "Fidelity Lifetime of Clustered and Clustering-Free Collection in Dual-Prediction Wireless Sensor Networks"
description: Trace-driven simulator, processed Intel Berkeley Lab data, per-run results and analysis scripts for the paper "Fidelity Lifetime of Clustered and Clustering-Free Collection in Dual-Prediction Wireless Sensor Networks". Ten collection policies share one dual-prediction core and are compared by fidelity lifetime on real readings and measured, asymmetric links.
